title: Official flow vs price divergence: disagreement weeks between speculative positioning flow and ETP price direction

blindness_declaration.law: This document is authored before anyone measures anything for this lane. It declares a mechanism, a rule FAMILY and a representation identity. It contains no outcome numbers, no returns conditional on states, no expectancies, and no signal arithmetic on positioning or prices beyond the structural facts committed in the P0/P1/P2 artifacts (consecutive-report differences of committed counts; sign of a readable weekly price direction as a declared structural coordinate of the joint state). All rule parameters are SYMBOLIC and freeze at D2/S selection, never after any scored number.

mechanism.narrative: Each weekly CoT report publishes what the reporting groups DID - the change in their net positions between consecutive reports - while the market shows what price DID over the same week. Usually the two agree: speculators add with the move. The informative state is the DISAGREEMENT cell of that joint outcome. The FORCED participant here is the speculator de-risking AGAINST the prevailing move: his selling into a falling week (or buying into a rising week) is the mechanical footprint of margin calls, risk-limit breaches or redemptions - pressure he did not choose and cannot time - because a view-driven participant adds WITH a move, while a forced one is moved against it. The mirror disagreement (speculators adding against the move) marks conviction or absorption: someone is funding the other side of a move nobody wants to chase, typically against commercial hedge flow. The LATE participant is the retail/ETP marginal holder, who has not yet reacted when the disagreement prints and becomes the liquidity the following resolution consumes. The declared family conditions on the joint state of (sign of weekly flow in noncommercial net positioning, from consecutive PIT-visible committed reports) x (sign of the same-week ETP price direction under the declared V7 close+1 readability convention); ONLY the two disagreement cells arm a position, with the direction convention set by the FLOW side (frozen), held for a symbolic window. The claim is about an OFFICIAL flow coordinate: price direction alone is one marginal of the joint state and carries the arm nowhere without the flow side - which is exactly what the mandatory price-only shadow (a joint state built from price marginals only) is designated to kill.

forced_participant.who: the large reporting speculator whose weekly net flow runs opposite to the week's price direction (de-risking into an adverse move), and mirror-wise the flow-absorbing side trading against commercial hedge demand
forced_participant.why_forced: position changes against the prevailing move are not view revisions; they are margin, risk-limit and redemption mechanics operating on a leveraged book inside a finite balance sheet - the participant is moved, not moving
forced_participant.late_participant: non-reporting small traders and ETP-linked retail flow, which react after the disagreement resolves and supply the liquidity the resolution consumes

mechanism.information_source: official CFTC legacy futures-only reports only for the flow coordinate (consecutive-report difference of committed noncommercial net counts, PIT-ordered); the price coordinate is the declared structural weekly-direction sign of the leg's own RAW EOD series read under the V7 close+1 convention - a coordinate of the joint state, never a return, never an expectancy, and never used alone
mechanism.state_definition_symbolic: state(t) = cell( s_flow(t), s_price(t) ), where s_flow(t) = sign( [noncomm_long - noncomm_short](r_t) - [noncomm_long - noncomm_short](r_{t-1}) ) from the two newest PIT-visible reports, and s_price(t) = sign of the leg's RAW close-to-close direction over the decision week ending at the last session STRICTLY BEFORE the decision instant (declared D1 convention, V7 close+1); ONLY the two disagreement cells (s_flow != s_price) arm a position; direction convention set by the FLOW side, frozen symmetric; persistence/holding window h SYMBOLIC, frozen at D2/S, never after; agreement cells are inert
mechanism.q16_instrument_note: the instrument is the ETP leg; weekly-scale holding keeps the Q-16 drag bill modest but non-zero: transaction component at tier 2.0 once per fill, measured expense accrual over the declared horizon, same-underlying tracking divergence as declared instrument fact (representation_identity.q16_instrument_declaration)

decision_rule_family: disagreement-state conditioning family on the ETP leg: arm a position ONLY in the two joint-state disagreement cells (official spec-flow sign opposite the same-week ETP price-direction sign), direction by the frozen flow-side sign convention, held a symbolic window h of decision-session closes; agreement cells inert; flow-difference definition, weekly-direction window endpoints and h are SYMBOLIC parameters, frozen at D2/S selection and never tuned after any scored number

representation_identity.law: P-12: code AND representation are committed before any number is cited; this declaration names the exact representation and cites every committed artifact by sha256; nothing here is measured and no signal is computed at D1

grid.definition: weekly decision grid per qualifying market-pair, materialized by the committed P2 census: every measured weekly CoT report with release date >= 2018-01-01, first 52 window instants declared warmup carve-out, counted window thereafter; bookable instants only

grid.decision_session: first MEASURED ETP session STRICTLY AFTER the release date (research/assets/commodities_ng1/clock.py::next_session_after, fail-closed when exhausted); the single unmapped counted release per pair (2026-09-11) is clock law, never a fabricated session
grid.decision_instant: the decision session's EOD close instant (16:00 America/New_York; 20:00Z EDT weeks, 21:00Z EST weeks)

ancestry_risk_statement.declaration: This proposal names the pooled kill-candidate shadows it must be novel against (plan section 1; D2 pooled |rho| screen) and states, per shadow, why official positioning information differs. This is the claim D2 will test; if any claim is false, the proposal dies at D2 by the pooled screen or by its own battery.

named_kill_candidates.why_different: the arm fires only in DISAGREEMENT cells, where the price coordinate and the official flow coordinate carry OPPOSITE signs; a momentum form is a function of the price coordinate alone and cannot distinguish a disagreement week from an agreement week with the same price path - the flow marginal is the orthogonal coordinate taken from an official report no price process contains. Honest admission: if in-sample the armed cells coincide (state rho beyond the frozen ceiling) with weeks selected by trailing-price forms, that is precisely the momentum_63s veto plus the price-only joint-state shadow, and the proposal dies
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: momentum_63s (generic price momentum; pooled D2 veto set)

named_kill_candidates.why_different: the release clock timestamps WHEN the joint state can update; the state itself is inert in agreement cells, so a fixed-direction weekly clock holds a position in weeks this family must be flat in, and vice versa. The release-clock shadow is the designated executioner: a fixed-direction arm pooled over all grid instants is exactly the dead calendar family; if it matches the anchor, the joint state adds nothing and the proposal dies
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: generic_dow_tue (calendar-clock forms; the CoT release weekday geometry)

named_kill_candidates.why_different: a displacement-fade opposes the most recent price move at a daily clock; this family's direction is set by the FLOW side, so in a disagreement cell it can be ALIGNED with the recent price move (spec flow up while price fell arms WITH the flow side) - the opposite polarity of a fade - and its clock is the weekly release grid. The honest residual risk: de-risking flow against a falling week often marks capitulation turns, so the family may correlate with reversal forms at the weekly scale; the price-only joint-state shadow (price sign vs lagged price sign) is the designated executioner for any purely price-timed reversal content
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: v16_close_displace_fade (short-horizon price reversal; pooled D2 veto set)

arms.name: flow-vs-price disagreement arm
arms.spec: the declared rule family: arm ONLY in the two joint-state disagreement cells (official spec-flow sign opposite the same-week price-direction sign), direction by the frozen flow-side convention, symbolic holding window h
arms.kill_semantics: anchor; killed by any designated KILLER control out-earning it (see falsification_rule)

arms.name: price-only joint-state shadow (MANDATORY, plan section 1)
arms.spec: the SAME tradeable rule (same clock, same 2x2 cell structure, same direction convention shape, same symbolic parameters) with BOTH marginals replaced by price-only analogues: e.g. the sign of the same-week price direction x the sign of the prior week's price direction - the pure price decomposition of the joint state; NO CoT input whatsoever; if the official-flow marginal adds nothing over its price-only decomposition, the family is price structure in disguise and dies
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the official flow coordinate adds nothing over price-only joint states (momentum_63s / v16 class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: bare release-clock shadow
arms.spec: identical holding shape and execution, FIXED direction sign, no state: every grid instant pooled (the bare Friday-release weekly clock)
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the joint state adds nothing over the generic release weekday clock (generic_dow_tue class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: stale-release placebo
arms.spec: the identical joint-state machinery with the flow coordinate taken from reports k release-instants OLDER than the PIT-visible pair (k symbolic, >= 4 releases, frozen at selection), price coordinate unchanged: preserves weekly clock and marginal rates while destroying the release-aligned flow-price coincidence that defines a disagreement; Q-11: too-few-eligible-instant outcomes are invalid/NOT_RUN, never zero
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the effect is release-aligned-information-independent and the proposal dies

arms.name: two-delay placement pair
arms.spec: the identical anchor rule at D0 = the P2 later-bound decision session and D1 = the next session after D0; both reported side by side
arms.kill_semantics: diagnostic for clock-placement artifacts; informs the D2 report, does not kill alone

arms.name: clairvoyant ceiling arm (Q-4)
arms.spec: same cell structure, but cell selection and side granted full-sample knowledge no live PIT process could have; ceiling reference only
arms.kill_semantics: NEVER selectable at S (P-15 smoke kills-never-selects); bounds a perfect oracle of this state; invalid vs null recorded (Q-11)

falsification_rule.statement: KILL if, at D2/I on the identical bookable grid, restricted leg set and window under the identical frozen cost treatment, ANY designated KILLER control (the price-only joint-state shadow, the bare release-clock shadow, or the stale-release placebo) earns a strictly greater after-cost per-decision edge than the ANCHOR arm. The price-only shadow matching the anchor means the disagreement state reduces to price-only joint structure (momentum_63s / v16 class); the release-clock shadow matching the anchor means the state adds nothing over the release weekday; the stale-release placebo matching the anchor means the release-aligned flow-price coincidence carries nothing. Declared now, outcome-blind; measurable later from the committed arms alone.
